title: New Application Ideas of Dynamics 365 Business Central (2026 MAR)
summary: A monthly roundup of community-submitted ideas for improving Business Central from March 2026, grouped by area: Copilot, data migration, development, finance, e-documents, localization, inventory, purchasing, sales, tenant administration and warehousing. Each entry gives the idea title and its author. It is a list of suggestions, not announced features.
key_points: Lists community improvement ideas from March 2026 by functional area, with each idea's author
Development ideas include native AL support for SQL READPAST, extra Shopify API fields and new or extended integration event parameters
Finance ideas include closing retained earnings by business unit and adding subscription contracts to the cash flow forecast
Localization ideas include Swiss eBill direct debit integration and embedding ZUGFeRD attachments
Tenant administration ideas include granular admin center roles and deleting users instead of only disabling them

quotes.text: Would any of these ideas improve Business Central? Here is a list of some of them.
quotes.why_it_matters: Frames the post as a compilation of potential improvements from the user community to enhance the platform
